tldr: 台股10月6日漲110.51點收49,822.55點，叩關5萬點失利，台積電續創歷史新高。
工研院估2026台灣半導體產值破7.13兆元，全球AI伺服器出貨衝上450萬台。
金管會新增三大試辦並將發布「金融大回饋指引」，央行連十季維持利率不變。
OPEC+維持10月產量，油價回落至每桶約88美元，金價自高檔小幅回落。

items.title_zh: 台股叩關5萬點失利 台積電領軍收斂漲勢
items.title_en: TAIEX stalls just below 50,000 as TSMC leads late profit-taking
items.summary_zh: 加權指數10月6日上漲110.51點、漲幅0.22%，收在49,822.55點，成交量約9,759億元。盤中一度衝高至約49,968點，距5萬點整數關卡僅約32點，隨後半導體權值股走弱，漲勢收斂。台積電終場上漲10元、收2,585元，撐住指數維持高檔，市場屏息等待即將登場的財報季。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index rose 110.51 points, or 0.22%, to close at 49,822.55 on Oct 6, with turnover of about NT$975.9bn. The market briefly climbed to roughly 49,968 intraday, within about 32 points of the 50,000 mark, before heavyweight semiconductors softened and trimmed the advance. TSMC ended up NT$10 at NT$2,585, keeping the index near record territory ahead of the coming earnings season.

items.title_zh: 台積電市值達66.77兆 一檔貢獻594點
items.title_en: TSMC market value tops NT$66.77tn, driving a fresh batch of records
items.summary_zh: 台積電10月6日創下多項紀錄，市值約達66.77兆元，單一個股即貢獻指數約594點。AI加速器帶動的先進製程產能需求持續強勁，支撐台積電股價維持高檔；由於權值占比龐大，大盤走勢高度連動台積電，投資人提前布局第3季財報行情。
items.summary_en: TSMC set multiple records on Oct 6, with market capitalisation reaching about NT$66.77tn and the stock single-handedly contributing roughly 594 points to the index. Sustained demand for advanced-node capacity tied to AI accelerators continues to underpin the chipmaker, whose weighting leaves the broader TAIEX closely tracking its moves as investors position for the Q3 results.

items.title_zh: 工研院估2026半導體產值破7兆 AI伺服器衝450萬台
items.title_en: ITRI sees 2026 chip output above NT$7tn, AI servers at 4.5 million units
items.summary_zh: 工研院與資策會MIC預估，台灣2026年半導體產值將突破7.13兆元、年增約10%，其中IC製造受惠3奈米滿載與2奈米放量，動能最強。全球AI伺服器出貨預估達450萬台、滲透率近三成，帶動先進製程產能連續四年成長逾四成，確立台灣在AI供應鏈的核心地位。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute and the MIC forecast the island's 2026 semiconductor output value will exceed NT$7.13tn, up about 10% on the year, led by IC manufacturing as 3nm runs full and 2nm ramps. Global AI-server shipments are projected to reach 4.5 million units with penetration near 30%, sustaining four straight years of 40%-plus growth in advanced-process capacity.

items.title_zh: 台廠AI動能不墜 主要IT廠營收連29個月增長
items.title_en: Taiwan's major IT makers extend record revenue streak on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台灣主要IT廠（含台積電、鴻海等）營收連續第29個月成長，7月合計營收年增逾五成、突破2兆元，為史上數一數二的單月增幅。強勁表現反映AI伺服器與先進晶片需求持續暢旺，市場預期供應鏈動能可望延續至年底，產業基本面維持穩健。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's leading IT manufacturers, including TSMC and Hon Hai, logged a 29th straight month of revenue growth, with July combined revenue jumping more than 50% year on year and topping NT$2tn, among the largest monthly gains on record. The surge reflects relentless AI-server and advanced-chip demand, reinforcing expectations that the supply chain will stay busy through year-end.

items.title_zh: 金管會新增三大試辦 將發布「金融大回饋指引」
items.title_en: FSC adds three pilot schemes, plans a "financial giveback" guideline
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆宣布為深化亞洲資產管理中心，新增「跨境服務」、「99人限制鬆綁」及「預繳保費帳戶」三大試辦項目，並將發布「金融大回饋指引」。截至4月底，相關政策已累計完成52項法規調適，金融業資產管理規模較2024年中增加10.62兆元，顯示資產管理制度逐步鬆綁與擴大。
items.summary_en: Financial Supervisory Commission chair Peng Jin-lung announced new pilots to deepen the Asian Asset Management Centre, including cross-border services, relaxing the 99-investor cap and prepaid-premium accounts, alongside a forthcoming "financial giveback" guideline. By end-April the policy had completed 52 regulatory adjustments, with industry assets under management up NT$10.62tn since mid-2024, signalling a steady widening of Taiwan's wealth-management framework.

items.title_zh: 金融三業2025稅前賺9880億 史上次高
items.title_en: Taiwan's financial trio booked NT$988bn pre-tax profit in 2025, second-highest ever
items.summary_zh: 金管會統計，2025年銀行、保險、證券三業稅前盈餘合計約9,880億元，為史上次高。銀行業以6,279億元居冠、年增約11%；保險業1,937億元、年減約43%，主因提列外匯價格變動準備金。主管機關重申「安全與發展並進」，在推動制度革新的同時兼顧金融穩定與風險控管。
items.summary_en: The banking, insurance and securities sectors posted combined pre-tax earnings of about NT$988bn in 2025, the second-highest on record. Banks led with NT$627.9bn, up about 11% year on year, while insurers' NT$193.7bn fell roughly 43% as firms set aside foreign-exchange volatility reserves. Regulators reiterated a balance of safety and development as the framework evolves.

items.title_zh: 台灣超高資產人數創高 配置偏向境外與月配息
items.title_en: Taiwan's ultra-high-net-worth ranks hit a record, tilting to offshore assets
items.summary_zh: 依中國信託《2026台灣超高資產客群報告》，2025年淨資產逾新台幣1億元者約12.3萬人，較2021年增加1.7萬人。超高資產客戶中74%持有境外資產，資產逾10億元者更高達86%。核心配置以股票型基金為主，偏好台股與科技類股；債券則鍾情新興市場債與月配息級別，呈現分散與收益並重的趨勢。
items.summary_en: CTBC's 2026 wealth report says the number of people with net assets above NT$100mn reached about 123,000 in 2025, up 17,000 from 2021. Some 74% of ultra-high-net-worth clients hold offshore assets, rising to 86% for those above NT$1bn. Core allocations centre on equity funds, especially Taiwan and tech names, with bonds favouring emerging-market and monthly-distribution tranches.

items.title_zh: 台新打造高資產財富管理平台 進駐高雄專區
items.title_en: Taishin builds a high-net-worth platform for the Kaohsiung asset hub
items.summary_zh: 台新銀行表示，為響應亞洲資產管理中心政策，攜手集團台新銀行、台新證券、台新投信及新光人壽共同進駐高雄資產管理專區，打造整合型高資產財富管理平台。透過跨子公司協作與集團資源整合，深化對高資產客群的信託、傳承與境外資產配置服務，呼應金融業搶進財富管理版圖的趨勢。
items.summary_en: Taishin Bank said it is answering the Asian Asset Management Centre policy by teaming up across the group — Taishin Bank, Taishin Securities, Taishin Investment Trust and Shin Kong Life — to enter the Kaohsiung special zone and build an integrated high-net-worth wealth-management platform. The move leverages cross-subsidiary collaboration to serve affluent clients, part of a broader push by banks and insurers into trust, succession and offshore-focused services.

items.title_zh: 財政部修「擬制遺產」課稅 2年內贈與併計
items.title_en: MOF tightens "deemed estate" rules on pre-death gifts
items.summary_zh: 財政部研擬修正遺產及贈與稅法相關規定，將被繼承人死亡前2年內贈與親屬的財產併入遺產總額課稅，並改由受贈人單獨負擔該部分稅負，不再由全體繼承人分攤。財政部表示正研擬修正施行細則等子法規，並調整申報書表及線上申辦系統，對高資產族的家族傳承與贈與規劃影響重大，須提前因應。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance is reworking how "deemed estate" is taxed: assets gifted to relatives within two years before death will be folded into the taxable estate and the tax borne solely by the recipient, rather than shared among all heirs. The ministry is drafting amendments to enforcement rules, filing forms and online systems so collection can follow, a change with meaningful implications for family succession planning.

items.title_zh: 房地合一稅鬆綁 家族股權移轉解套
items.title_en: House-and-land tax eased for certain family share transfers
items.summary_zh: 財政部修正房地合一課徵所得稅申報作業要點，針對特定股權交易放寬規定，即日生效並適用於尚未核課或尚未核課確定的案件。若出售股權於2021年6月30日前取得、且公司持有的不動產部分在2015年12月31日前取得，其利得可依舊制房地占比部分免稅，有助化解家族股權移轉卡關問題，降低傳承稅負不確定性。
items.summary_en: The MOF relaxed house-and-land income-tax treatment for specific share transactions, effective immediately and applicable to cases not yet assessed or finalised. Where shares were acquired before June 30, 2021 and the company holds property partly obtained before end-2015, gains may qualify for partial exemption under the old property-ratio rules, helping unblock long-stalled family equity transfers.

items.title_zh: 央行連十季利率不變 上修通膨與成長預測
items.title_en: Central bank holds rates, lifts inflation and growth forecasts
items.summary_zh: 央行第3季理監事會維持利率不變，為連續第10季按兵不動，同時上修2026年CPI年增率預測至約2.03%，略高於2%警戒線。總裁楊金龍表示仍有時間觀察物價，並強調自2024年以來貨幣政策操作偏緊。央行亦上修下半年經濟成長預測，反映AI等新興應用帶動出口與投資動能強勁，景氣基調穩健。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's central bank kept its policy rate unchanged at its Q3 board meeting — a tenth straight quarter on hold — while nudging up its 2026 CPI forecast to around 2.03%, above the 2% alert line. Governor Yang Chin-long said there is still time to watch prices and stressed that monetary policy has stayed on the tight side since 2024, with the bank also upgrading its second-half growth outlook on strong AI-driven momentum.

items.title_zh: 賴清德：落實亞洲資產管理中心計畫
items.title_en: President Lai vows to deepen the Asian Asset Management Centre
items.summary_zh: 總統賴清德重申政府推動亞洲資產管理中心的決心，表示台灣金融業下一階段將深化資產管理路線。該計畫自2024年9月推動以來，已帶動數十項法規調適與資產管理規模兆元級成長，並將財富與資產管理定位為國家經濟政策的戰略支柱，盼吸引資金回台並壯大本土金融服務業的國際競爭力。
items.summary_en: President Lai Ching-te reaffirmed the government's push to realise the Asian Asset Management Centre, saying Taiwan's finance sector will deepen its asset-management route in the next phase. The initiative, running since September 2024, has driven dozens of regulatory adjustments and double-digit-trillion growth in managed assets, positioning wealth and asset management as a strategic pillar of national economic policy.

items.title_zh: OPEC+維持10月產量 國際油價回落
items.title_en: Oil eases as OPEC+ holds October output steady (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 國際油價10月6日回落，西德州中級原油（WTI）跌至每桶約88美元、單日下跌約1.6%，主因沙烏地阿拉伯、俄羅斯等OPEC+成員同意10月產量維持與9月相同。供給政策穩定加上美元偏強，壓抑能源價格。對台灣等依賴進口的經濟體而言是小幅喘息，但油價仍處於歷史相對高檔，後續通膨壓力值得留意。
items.summary_en: Crude prices softened on Oct 6, with WTI slipping to around US$88 a barrel, down roughly 1.6% on the day, after OPEC+ members including Saudi Arabia and Russia agreed to keep October production unchanged from September. Steady supply policy alongside a firmer dollar capped energy prices, a modest relief for import-reliant economies such as Taiwan even as crude stays historically elevated.

items.title_zh: 金價自高檔小幅回落 殖利率回穩
items.title_en: Gold slips from record highs as yields steady (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 黃金10月6日回落至每盎司約4,121美元、較前一日下跌約0.4%，自歷史高檔區小幅回檔，主因美債殖利率與美元走勢回穩。金價維持高檔，反映2026年以來各國央行持續買進及避險需求不墜；此次小跌屬於整理而非趨勢反轉，黃金仍是資產配置者重要的分散工具，法人多維持逢回布局的看法。
items.summary_en: Gold eased to about US$4,121 an ounce on Oct 6, down roughly 0.4% from the prior day, pulling back modestly from record territory as Treasury yields and the dollar stabilised. The metal's elevated level reflects persistent central-bank buying and safe-haven demand through 2026; the small dip reads as consolidation rather than a trend reversal, keeping bullion a core diversifier for asset allocators.

items.title_zh: 標普、那指收盤創新高 科技股領漲
items.title_en: S&P 500 and Nasdaq close at records as tech leads (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 美股10月6日收高，標普500指數漲0.58%至歷史新高7,818.93點，道瓊漲0.49%收51,521.28點，那斯達克綜合指數漲0.45%收27,599.79點。美債殖利率回落與大型科技股表現強勁帶動漲勢，推升標普與那指再創歷史新高。投資人在第3季財報季登場前加碼AI基礎建設題材，市場風險偏好維持高昂。
items.summary_en: U.S. stocks ended higher on Oct 6, with the S&P 500 up 0.58% to a record 7,818.93, the Dow gaining 0.49% to 51,521.28 and the Nasdaq Composite rising 0.45% to 27,599.79. Cooling Treasury yields and resilient mega-cap technology drove the advance, lifting the S&P and Nasdaq to fresh all-time highs as investors leaned into the AI-infrastructure trade ahead of the third-quarter earnings season.

items.title_zh: 輝達、超微齊創新高 AI樂觀帶動晶片股
items.title_en: Nvidia and AMD hit record highs on AI optimism (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）與超微（AMD）股價10月6日同步收在歷史新高，帶動晶片類股全面走揚，華爾街上調半導體目標價。分析師認為，即便股價勁揚，科技股評價相對AI驅動的獲利成長仍屬合理。此番走勢凸顯AI基礎建設需求持續將市場主導權集中於少數晶片大廠，資金向AI供應鏈靠攏的趨勢未歇。
items.summary_en: Shares of Nvidia and AMD both closed at record highs on Oct 6, leading a broad chip-sector rally as Wall Street lifted semiconductor price targets. Analysts argued that despite the gains, tech valuations still look reasonable against AI-driven earnings growth. The move underscored how AI-infrastructure demand continues to concentrate market leadership in a handful of chipmakers.

items.title_zh: 輝達市值逼近6兆美元 華爾街調升評等
items.title_en: Nvidia nears a US$6 trillion valuation after Wall Street upgrade (2026-10-06)
items.summary_zh: 輝達股價10月6日續創新高，市值逼近約6兆美元，主因華爾街調升評等並帶動整體晶片類股。市場看好其即將推出的新硬體與資料中心需求延續，持續加碼這檔AI指標股。輝達市值已遠超多數全球同業，成為本波科技股主導行情的核心支柱；惟評價偏高亦使其股價波動對大盤影響加大，須留意回檔風險。
items.summary_en: Nvidia climbed toward a roughly US$6 trillion market value on Oct 6 after a Wall Street upgrade lifted the chip sector, with the stock pushing to a fresh record. Enthusiasm over upcoming hardware and sustained data-centre demand kept investors bidding up the AI leader, whose market cap now dwarfs most global peers and anchors the technology-led leg of the current equity rally.

items.title_zh: 標普500首度收上7,800點 殖利率降溫助攻
items.title_en: S&P 500 posts first close above 7,800 as yields cool (2026-10-05)
items.summary_zh: 前一交易日（10月5日），標普500指數首度收在7,800點之上，主因科技股走強及美債殖利率自多年高點回落。此一里程碑為隔日再創新高鋪路，反映投資人日益相信：利率壓力緩解加上AI驅動的獲利成長，可望延續美股多頭行情。不過指數快速走高後，市場對評價偏高與追高風險的討論同步升溫。
items.summary_en: In the prior session on Oct 5, the S&P 500 closed above 7,800 for the first time, boosted by technology gains and cooler Treasury yields retreating from multiyear highs. The milestone set the stage for the following day's fresh record, reflecting growing investor conviction that easing rate pressure and AI-driven earnings can keep powering the U.S. equity bull run.
